description: JRC Travel Time to Major Cities is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Transport and Communications", published or maintained by the publisher of forobs.jrc.ec.europa.eu. Travel time to the nearest major city ( 50,000 people) across the whole world, at approximately 1km resolution. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "Transport and Communications". The entry links to forobs.jrc.ec.europa.eu. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
